subject: general
question: Which of the following components is a part of a diesel engine only?
solution:
The correct answer is __Spray nozzle.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Spray nozzle__ is used only in diesel engines.
 
• It atomizes the diesel fuel into fine droplets for efficient combustion.
 
• Unlike __carburetors__, which are used in petrol engines, spray nozzles are designed specifically for diesel engines.
 
• Diesel engines do not require spark plugs as they rely on compression ignition, unlike petrol engines.
 
• Fuel tanks are common across both petrol and diesel engines, but spray nozzles are unique to diesel engines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Carburetor:**

 
 
• It is used in petrol engines to mix air and fuel before combustion.
 
• Diesel engines do not use carburetors as they inject fuel directly into the combustion chamber.
 
 
 
• **Spark Plug:**
 
 
• Spark plugs are used in petrol engines to ignite the air-fuel mixture.
 
• Diesel engines rely on compression ignition and therefore do not require spark plugs.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Tank:**
 
 
• It is a common component found in both petrol and diesel engines.
 
• Its role is to store fuel, which is then supplied to the engine.
